prompt_en: long serpent body with emerald and bronze scales, two broad leathery bat-like wings, crested head with forked tongue and curved fangs, and a barbed tail tip, coiled on a rock
nota: Clase amplia (wyvern, vouivre): dragón menor que escupe veneno desde el aire.

prompt_en: huge grey stallion with eight slender legs, four on each side, flowing silver mane and tail, faint glowing runes along the flanks and calm pale eyes
nota: Montura de Odín. Ocho patas: su galope es difícil de leer.

prompt_en: slender white horse with a long spiral ivory horn, cloven goat-like hooves, a small beard and a lion-tufted tail, silver-white mane and calm bright eyes
nota: Su cuerno cura y purifica; objetivo prioritario si acompaña a otros enemigos.

prompt_en: stocky beast with an antelope body, golden spotted hide, an elephant-like tail, black boar tusks, and two long curved horns that swivel independently forward and back
nota: Cuernos giratorios: cada uno apunta a un lado; los avisos se cruzan.

prompt_en: colossal bird with vast dark-blue feathered wings that blot out the sun, golden talons, a crested head with a hooked beak, and storm clouds gathering around its shoulders
nota: Jefe aéreo: su sombra avisa de la zambullida; tradición hebrea, tratar con respeto.

prompt_en: storm demon shaped like a swirling dark cloud with a huge fanged mouth, wild tangled hair of black mist, long clawed arms and rattling hailstones falling from its body
nota: Demonio del granizo: su boca abierta es el punto débil tras cada ráfaga.

prompt_en: small black rooster-like creature with a long serpentine fiery tail trailing sparks, glowing ember eyes, short scaled wings, and glittering coins clutched in its talons
nota: Duende del tesoro: su estela de chispas anuncia la embestida; roba monedas.

prompt_en: hulking hunched old ogress with grey warty skin, two short curved horns, a hooked nose, tattered dark shawl, long clawed hands and a large sack slung over her back
nota: Ogra de cuentos para asustar niños; golpes lentos con el saco, hay que esquivar.

prompt_en: graceful riverbank guardian spirit with long pale-green hair, flowing robes that ripple like water, glowing white eyes and a cupped hand spilling a shimmering stream
nota: Protectoras de orillas según interpretaciones modernas. Envuelven a aliados en velos de agua.

prompt_en: hairy horned demon with a goat-like muzzle, cloven hooves, thick dark fur, a long tail, curved black horns and glowing yellow eyes, wielding a heavy wooden club
nota: Diablo eslavo, base de Boruta; golpes pesados que se esquivan en lugar de parar.

prompt_en: devil disguised as a nobleman in a long red coat and fur cap with a drooping moustache, tall black boots, small horns poking through the hat and a hooked tail beneath the coat
nota: Disfrazado de noble: el primer aviso es falso, el segundo es real.

prompt_en: gaunt spectral woman in a long tattered white shroud, face hidden by a hood with only pale eyes visible, trailing greenish plague mist from her sleeves over the ground
nota: Peste personificada: nubes de miasma que obligan a moverse, no a parar.

prompt_en: wild forest woman with long matted green-black hair, pointed ears, bark-like leathery skin, very long clawed arms, a ragged moss-covered cloak and a bundle of twigs on her back
nota: Cambia niños por los suyos; agarra desde la maleza, el aviso es corto.

prompt_en: pale gaunt vampire in a dark wolf-pelt cloak, sunken red eyes, long fangs, clawed hands, and a ragged grey coat, with a wolf-like muzzle half-forming on its face
nota: Vampiro cambiaformas de Istria; el kresnik es su némesis. Se lanza y se retira.

prompt_en: tall forest spirit woman with bark-brown skin, hair of long green leaves and vines, birch-white arms, glowing green eyes, moss-covered shoulders and bare feet sinking into the ground
nota: Esposa del leshy: imita voces para desorientar; el eco falso no hace daño.

prompt_en: pale young woman spirit with long green hair crowned with wildflowers, a thin white dress of leaves, glowing pale eyes, and a hollow back of ivy and tangled roots instead of a spine
nota: Atrae con su canto; la espalda hueca delata la ilusión.

prompt_en: pale bluish young female ghost with wet dark hair clinging to her shoulders, a tattered grey-blue shift, milky white eyes, dripping hands and a hollow back filled with reeds and pond water
nota: Mavka pálida: espíritus de muertos en grupo; el corte de luna los dispersa.

prompt_en: hunched night hag spirit floating above the ground, long straggly black hair, grey cracked skin, glowing yellow eyes, a ragged dark nightgown dissolving into smoke and long thin clawed fingers
nota: Maldice con pesadillas e insomnio; conviene cortarla primero.

prompt_en: tall shaggy wild man of the mountain forest, covered in long coarse brown fur, heavy brow and yellow tusk-like teeth, enormously long arms and a gnarled club made from a pine trunk
nota: Hombre salvaje georgiano; golpes lentos y largos, ideal para esquivar.

prompt_en: long-bodied lake dragon with dark teal scales, a frilled crest along its neck, fish-like fins, glowing amber eyes and a wide toothy jaw, rising from the water in a spray of mist
nota: Dudosa: «ozero» significa lago en eslavo; probablemente un dragón lacustre genérico.

prompt_en: small hunched folk spirit wrapped in a patched woolen cloak, pale grey face with large dark eyes, long thin fingers, a twisted wooden staff and a faint mist swirling around its feet
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; espíritu balcánico genérico, a confirmar con fuentes.

prompt_en: falcon wreathed in flames with a golden-orange feathered body, a burning crest and tail like a comet, glowing white-hot eyes and talons that leave small sparks in the air
nota: Ave de fuego eslava (halcón); lanza chispas desde el aire.

prompt_en: colossal white-bearded old god in a billowing grey-blue cloak, his beard and robes streaming into gusts of wind, holding a great curved horn, with arrow-shaped gales swirling behind him
nota: Dios de los vientos; sus nietos-viento disparan flechas de aire desde lejos.

prompt_en: drowned woman spirit with pale blue-grey skin, long dripping black hair tangled with pond weed, a torn white shift soaked in water, glowing white eyes and webbed fingers
nota: Forma femenina del topielec: agarra desde el agua y arrastra hacia abajo.

prompt_en: tall serene woman guardian in a deep midnight-blue robe scattered with silver stars, long dark hair, a pale glowing crescent crown and a slender spear of starlight in her hand
nota: Guardiana de estrellas: protege a los suyos; mejor como PNJ o jefa.

prompt_en: small kindly house spirit woman with rosy cheeks, a patched apron and shawl, white hair in a bun, carrying a broom and a lantern, with faint hearth embers glowing at her feet
nota: «Mujer de la casa»: espíritu protector del hogar; encaja como PNJ o aliada.

prompt_en: small ghostly stable-boy spirit with translucent pale-blue skin, ragged old tunic, a hooded green cloak, hollow sad eyes and frost on his hair, floating just above the stone floor
nota: Fantasma del castillo de Hylton: mueve cosas y huye; la capa verde lo apacigua.

prompt_en: gaunt sorceress in a tattered black-green robe with a hooded cowl, long grey hair, hollow glowing green eyes, holding a twisted staff that sheds withered leaves and blight
nota: Probable Carman, hechicera de la plaga; sus tres hijos podrían ser acólitos.

prompt_en: large black dog with shaggy coat, pale ghostly eyes and a dusting of grave soil, a broken iron bell tied at its collar and faint white mist drifting from its fur
nota: Guardián del cementerio: embiste sin poder pararse, hay que esquivar y contraatacar.

prompt_en: small grey poltergeist spirit shaped like a stooped goblin made of dust and shadow, with a large wooden mallet, wide hollow eyes and a ring of floating cracked plates around it
nota: Dudosa: espíritu de golpes nocturnos; sus golpes falsos funcionan como avisos que engañan.

prompt_en: tall gaunt elf king in a dark green hooded robe, a crown of twisted alder branches, long pale face with hollow glowing eyes, and a trailing cape of grey mist and falling leaves
nota: Rey de los elfos: susurra para atraer; su niebla oculta ataques reales y falsos.

prompt_en: tiny winged fairy with moth-like grey wings, pointed face and large dark eyes, a tattered leaf tunic, thin limbs and a faint trail of glittering dust as it flutters
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; hada británica genérica, en enjambres de 4 a 8.

prompt_en: small green-skinned water goblin with thin spindly arms twice as long as its body, webbed claws, sharp needle teeth, bulging yellow eyes and slimy weed draped over its back
nota: Acecha en estanques: sus brazos largos agarran desde el agua; el aviso es corto.

prompt_en: small hairy house goblin with shaggy brown fur, pointed ears, bright round eyes, a tattered tunic and bare feet, holding a tiny pitchfork and a bowl of cream
nota: Hace tareas si lo tratan bien; ofendido, molesta y se va. Buen PNJ.
No es criatura: raya disecada y retocada que se vendía como demonio o sirena.

prompt_en: colossal sea serpent with a mountain-sized head, a wide fanged maw with a forked tongue, ridged slate-green scales, barnacled coils across the waves and toxic vapor rising from its breath
nota: Jefe de Orcadas: la leyenda lo vence desde dentro, quemándole el hígado.

prompt_en: huge shaggy black dog the size of a calf, two glowing red eyes, long fangs, smoky breath and heavy paws that leave scorched prints in the mud
nota: Nombre regional del Black Shuck de Anglia Oriental; mismo cuerpo, paleta de niebla.

prompt_en: tall spectral hound with shaggy pale-grey fur, silent oversized paws, glowing round eyes, a dragging rusted chain and a trail of fog at its heels
nota: Perro espectral de Yorkshire: pasos silenciosos, aparece de la niebla y muerde.

prompt_en: stooped river spirit covered in rattling sea shells and pebbles from head to foot, pale wrinkled face with a wide grin, long beard of river weed and a clacking shell-cloak
nota: Desorienta junto al río; el tintineo de conchas delata su verdadera posición.

prompt_en: tiny fairy man with a wrinkled brown face, pointed hat made from a dock leaf, patched green jacket, long nimble fingers and bright quick eyes, poised on a gorse bush
nota: Hada de Cornualles: escurridiza, ataca y desaparece entre los tojos.

prompt_en: slender water sprite with translucent blue-green skin, long reed-like hair, webbed fingers, shimmering fish-scale patches along its arms and soft glowing eyes, standing waist-deep in a pool
nota: Dudosa: nombre galés de espíritus acuáticos según el catálogo; no la reconozco.

prompt_en: small bearded mine goblin with grey leathery skin, a dented miner's helmet with a dim lamp, big ears, oversized hands gripping a tiny pickaxe and a coat of rock dust
nota: Versión americana del knocker; grupos que golpean la roca antes de un derrumbe.

prompt_en: wild goat-legged man with shaggy russet fur on his lower body, small curled horns, a mossy beard, pointed ears, and a cloak of reeds, perched by a mountain waterfall
nota: Sátiro de las cascadas escocesas; solitario, salta y huye si lo ves venir.

prompt_en: tall man-like creature with a wolf's head covered in short brown fur, strong shoulders, calm amber eyes, a rough rope belt and a freshly caught fish held in one hand
nota: Pacífico salvo que lo ofendan; deja pescado a los pobres. Duelo de honor.

prompt_en: hulking underworld demon with iron-grey skin, a single large eye, jagged tusks, asymmetric body with one huge clawed arm, shaggy dark fur cloak and cold breath rising like frost
nota: Demonios yakutos del mundo inferior (el catálogo los ubica mal en África).

prompt_en: small unicorn-like beast with a stocky antelope-like body, tan coat, a single short straight horn on the forehead, sturdy legs and alert dark eyes
nota: Dudosa: fuentes coloniales poco claras; unicornio pequeño según el catálogo.

prompt_en: tall gaunt desert ogre with sand-colored skin and long limbs, a large staring eye on the instep of each foot, a wide toothy mouth, crouching low to raise one foot like a lantern
nota: Khoikhoi: ojos en los pies; debe levantar el pie para ver, ahí queda abierto.

prompt_en: tiny forest sprite with glowing amber skin, big leaf-shaped ears, a crown of small red flowers, a bark-colored tunic, a spark of fire in cupped hands and a gourd of herbs
nota: Hadas fon del bosque que ayudan a humanos; encajan como PNJ o apoyo.

prompt_en: gigantic black serpent rising from a deep well with seven crowned heads, glowing golden eyes, gold-flecked scales and coils glistening like wet obsidian
nota: Serpiente guardiana de Wagadu; algunas versiones le dan siete cabezas.

prompt_en: shadowy hulking beast with dark shaggy fur, long curved claws, glowing yellow eyes, a heavy hunched back and a mouth full of uneven teeth, emerging from tall grass
nota: Dudosa: quizá el «dodo» hausa, monstruo genérico para asustar niños.

prompt_en: small wiry forest spirit with dark bark-like skin, a wild crown of leaves, long fingers, bright white eyes, carrying a carved wooden staff and a woven gourd
nota: Dudosa: espíritu del bosque yoruba; el objeto que porta no lo conozco.

prompt_en: tall river spirit shaped from flowing clear water in a vaguely human form, glowing white eyes, hair of trailing reeds, pearly shell ornaments and ripples spreading from its feet
nota: Categoría ewe, no una criatura única; relleno de ríos. Tratar con respeto.

prompt_en: huge river beast with a broad armored back of dark green scales, a wide blunt snout with thick tusks, powerful webbed legs and small glowing eyes just above the waterline
nota: Dudosa: bestia fluvial liberiana, sin detalles fiables; diseño genérico de río.

prompt_en: tiny forest dwarf with bark-textured brown skin, big pointed ears, feet turned backwards, a cloak of leaves, a pouch of herbs and a small stone ready to throw
nota: Duendes akan de pies al revés; grupos que lanzan piedras y huyen.

prompt_en: slender shadowy spirit with long limbs, smooth dark grey skin, a pale mask-like face with narrow glowing eyes, wrapped in drifting wisps of mist and carrying a gnarled staff
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; figura sobrenatural africana genérica, a confirmar con fuentes.

prompt_en: small rooster-like creature with a long serpentine tail of golden embers, sandy-red feathers, short scaled wings, glowing amber eyes and a copper ring around its neck
nota: Comparativo sin tradición africana: es el Aitvaras báltico con paleta de sabana.

prompt_en: gaunt shadowy sorcerer spirit with a tall hooded silhouette of smoke-grey cloth, glowing amber eyes, long thin fingers trailing sparks, and wisps of dark vapor instead of feet
nota: Categoría de brujería azande; evitar caricaturas de la hechicería africana.

prompt_en: squat earth spirit with a rounded clay-brown body cracked like dry mud, long dangling arms, small bright eyes, a wide silent mouth and dust rising from its shoulders
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; espíritu centroafricano genérico, a confirmar con fuentes.

prompt_en: broad-shouldered spirit brute with ash-grey skin, a heavy brow, short horns of twisted bark, large hands and a long cloak of dry grass, walking with slow heavy steps
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; figura austral genérica, a confirmar con fuentes.

prompt_en: lanky wild-haired forest being with shaggy dark fur, long arms, a pale narrow face with glowing eyes and clawed fingers, half hidden among tall tangled roots
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; ser de lugares salvajes, posiblemente malgache.

prompt_en: river beast the size of a rhinoceros with a spotted leopard-like head, two long curved walrus tusks, armored overlapping scales along the back and a broad lobed tail
nota: Críptido de Kenia: híbrido de leopardo, morsa y reptil; vuelca canoas desde el río.

prompt_en: huge shaggy savanna beast with a low heavy body, mottled sandy-grey hide, a broad flat head with small dark eyes, thick legs and a ridge of coarse hair along its back
nota: Dudosa: «Galla» es exónimo antiguo (oromo); relato colonial sin criatura definida.

prompt_en: heavy bear-hyena beast with a sloping back, shaggy reddish-brown fur, long powerful forelimbs with large claws, a broad blunt head, small round ears and a short stubby tail
nota: Críptido de Kenia, ligado al chemosit nandi; golpes lentos y potentes.

prompt_en: giant black bat-like flier with twelve-foot leathery wings, a pointed muzzle with sharp white teeth, long clawed wing-fingers, a narrow body and a thin whip-like tail
nota: Críptido de Camerún, no del este: pasa rasante y vuelve por la espalda.

prompt_en: scavenger hybrid with a hyena-like body, patchy spotted grey fur, a long bald vulture-like neck and hooked head, strong forelegs, a drooping tail and pale watchful eyes
nota: Dudosa: carroñero híbrido según el catálogo; no conozco fuentes fiables.

prompt_en: tall thin spirit with elongated limbs that look like twisted charred wood, glowing yellow eyes, a body of curling dark smoke and a faint swirling silhouette instead of legs
nota: «Shetani» (de shaytan) es término suajili amplio; relleno de espíritus malignos.

prompt_en: two-headed serpent with sandy-brown and olive scales, a head at each end, crested brows, forked tongues, and a thick muscular body coiled around a river rock
nota: Comparativo sin tradición africana; no copiar el Sisiutl sagrado kwakwaka'wakw.

prompt_en: clever oversized hare with sleek sandy-brown fur, very long ears, powerful hind legs, a sly grin and bright eyes, a small gourd hanging from a cord around its neck
nota: Embaucador de cuentos bantúes (Kalulu, Sungura); deja señuelos que no dañan.

prompt_en: immense rainbow-banded serpent coiled along a winding river, scales shimmering from deep violet to gold and green, a gentle wide head with calm glowing eyes, water flowing from its coils
nota: Serpiente ancestral noongar creadora de ríos: solo lore o PNJ, nunca enemigo.

prompt_en: sleek nocturnal beast with a dark grey coat, long limbs, large reflective amber eyes, pointed ears and a low prowling posture, faint moonlit mist swirling around its paws
nota: Significa «animales de la noche» en suajili: categoría; manadas de 4 a 8.

prompt_en: towering column of river water shaped like a vague hooded figure, glowing pale blue eyes, spray and foam streaming from its arms, with fish scales and driftwood caught in its body
nota: Categoría del Zambeze; relleno acuático. Tratar con respeto a tradiciones locales.

prompt_en: night spirit of a mountain village, a tall shadowy figure with a pale mask-like face and two dim glowing eyes, wrapped in a dark cloak of drifting mist and moths
nota: Dudosa: requiere verificación; Zinacantán es un municipio maya de Chiapas, no África.

prompt_en: gentle spring spirit rising from a mountain pool, a translucent figure of clear water with a halo of mist, long flowing hair of rippling currents and soft white glowing eyes
nota: Dudosa: «arzhaan» designa manantiales sagrados curativos en Tuvá; sin criatura clara.

prompt_en: large spirit cat standing on its hind legs with thick silver-white lynx fur, tufted ears, ice-blue eyes, frost crystals along its whiskers and a long ringed tail swirling with snow
nota: Categoría comparativa de espíritus felinos; no es el bakeneko japonés. Reskin nevado.

prompt_en: bulky lake beast with a seal-like dark brown body, shaggy mane around a horse-like head, long tusks, flipper limbs and a thick tail, lurking in cold grey water with ice floes
nota: Nombre comparativo moderno, no una criatura tradicional; reskin lacustre del bunyip.

prompt_en: tall hairy snow-dwelling giant covered in thick grey-brown fur, heavy brow, very long arms, frost crusted in its fur and enormous bare feet leaving deep prints
nota: Probable Chuchunaa yakuto: gigante peludo de la tundra; golpes lentos.
Posible error del catálogo: Dersu Uzala fue un cazador nanai real, no un espíritu.

prompt_en: gaunt underworld servant with ash-grey skin, a horned iron helmet, glowing red eyes, a ragged black cloak, a curved blade and rusted chains, trailing cold dark smoke
nota: Séquito de Erlik, señor del inframundo túrquico; aparecen en grupos de 4 a 8.

prompt_en: large steppe beast with a heavy shaggy mane of coarse brown fur, a broad wolf-like head, thick limbs ending in broad claws, small deep-set eyes and a long ragged tail
nota: Dudosa: Hulagu fue un kan mongol; no conozco ninguna bestia con ese nombre.

prompt_en: dark shapeless night wraith with a hunched silhouette of black smoke, two pale slit eyes, long thin dangling arms and drifting wisps of cold sand and shadow around it
nota: Dudosa: no la reconozco; figura nocturna del miedo, a confirmar con fuentes.

prompt_en: giant glossy black spider with thirteen red spots on its swollen abdomen, long thin legs, dripping fangs and a pale spirit-like mist halo, clinging to a rocky overhang
nota: Dudosa: karakurt es una araña real (viuda negra); espíritu no documentado.
